findings: ends[0] marker hidden by the sweep line (confirmed): when ends[0] + 1 == left, the marker at x(top.end + 1) and the sweep line at x(current.left) have the same x, and the sweep line is drawn on top. This happens in 3 of 5 True checks in the default example and in every preset. Move or offset the marker, and extend the picture overlap test (and the CDP probe) to cover SVG <line> marks.

Free green matches G2's color (confirmed): --mg2406-g1 is the same hex as --mg2406-green in both themes, so a free G1 lane looks like a G2 lane (see shot-light.png). g8 is also close to the busy red. Use group colors that differ from the status colors, or mark free/busy with something besides fill.
SVG aria-label is English only (confirmed): mg2406Picture always uses 'N groups'. Use copy.groups so the Vietnamese page is consistent.
